purpose: Define governed tool invocation and result handling so exact tool/target/arguments are validated and authorized, while returned data remains inert until explicitly consumed.

owns: Tool Invocation and Result Boundary semantics

value.invocation_rule: Invocation resolves exact registered #T tool identity.
value.binding_rule: Concrete invocation resolves exact validated MCP/local implementation binding.
value.argument_rule: Arguments validate against tool schema before dispatch.
value.authorization_rule: Caller/session AccessCore and assurance constraints are evaluated independently from model/tool recommendation.
value.execution_rule: Invocation receives a distinct runtime execution identity.
value.result_rule: Tool result is inert data with exact tool/invocation/source provenance.
value.effect_rule: A returned command-like string or structured object does not execute automatically.
value.chain_rule: Any subsequent operation requested from tool output crosses the normal validate/authorize/dispatch boundary again.
value.failure_rule: Timeout/error/schema violation is explicit and cannot masquerade as successful result.

invariants.rule: MCP endpoint identity, advertised capability, validated #T tool identity, concrete invocation and returned result are separate identities; advertisement or availability never grants execution authority.

references.purpose: Tool/model outputs remain inert until normal dispatch boundary.
